title: Engineering Efficient Self-Play Chess: Search, Replay, and Throughput Under Limited Compute
abstract: arXiv:2609.37447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How strong can an AlphaZero-style chess system become under limited training compute when its entire learning loop is engineered for efficiency? We train from random initialization through searched self-play on a single eight-GPU node for 2.5 days. The resulting 6.32-million-parameter model reaches 3,251 benchmark Elo [3,206, 3,297] at 100,000 searches per move (estimated at under five seconds of thinking time) against a fixed-node Stockfish 13 ladder. The run ingests 3.25 million completed games, involves an estimated 100 billion search simulations, and makes 836.6 million training presentations. We investigate search allocation, replay and restart-state selection, policy representation, progressive model sizing, quantized inference, and throughput engineering. translated_title: 工程化高效自博弈国际象棋：有限算力下的搜索、回放与吞吐量优化
translated_abstract: 当整个学习循环都为效率而精心设计时，一个AlphaZero风格的国际象棋系统在有限训练算力下能达到多强？我们在单个八GPU节点上，通过搜索式自博弈从随机初始化开始训练了2.5天。所得的632万参数模型在对固定节点数Stockfish 13梯队的评测中，在每步10万次搜索（估计思考时间不足五秒）的条件下达到3,251基准Elo [3,206, 3,297]。整个运行过程消化了325万盘完整对局，涉及约1000亿次搜索模拟，并完成了8.366亿次训练样本呈现。我们研究了搜索资源分配、回放与重启状态选择、策略表示、渐进式模型规模扩展、量化推理以及吞吐量工程等方面。除了最终保留的设计方案，我们还记录了一些看似合理但未能改进完整学习循环或性价比不足的替代方案。所报告的棋力是一个重
tldr: 通过对AlphaZero式自博弈学习循环的全方位效率工程优化，该系统仅用单节点八GPU训练2.5天，就让632万参数的模型达到了约3251 Elo的棋力。
en_tdlr: By engineering the entire AlphaZero-style self-play learning loop for efficiency, a 6.32M-parameter model achieves ~3,251 Elo after just 2.5 days of training on a single 8-GPU node.
